name: Page popup
description: Shows a configurable popup message on specific pages.
project_description:
Page popup module is very useful module. Site admin or authenticated user can show popup message, quote's or hint's on specific pages. User can also able to configure popup message text color, background color, font-size, width, height, position & popup delay.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 This module will create an admin configuration page.

admin/config/system/page_popup

This configuration page will have option to add popup message entity. After adding popup entity user can update message color, font size etc. using Popup seetings option.

 Back to top 

 Try it on simplytest.me 
 simplytest.me 

 Also user can disable popup message.
